ache.title: Powercreep is the game telling you to buy again
ache.note: Nero talks about future banners and how Eidolons keep getting more important for team efficiency, with Herta E2 as the example. When a character needs duplicates to keep up, the game is moving the finish line on purpose. Your account isn’t falling behind; the target is running away.
watch: powercreep making old pulls feel weak
ache.tip: When power needs dupes, step off the ladder. Play the story and modes you enjoy at your own pace.
lines: powercreep is a moving finish line
he saw it coming and still planned pulls

title: Herta E2 Powercreep: The Future | Honkai Star Rail
excerpt: In this episode, I talk about future banners, and how choices are influenced by Eidolons becoming more and more important, when it comes to team efficiency in the game. Stay tuned, because I mean to publish at least a couple more videos - and probably one encompassing article - about this topic soon.
